turns.query: At Causeway Bay station (station_id 17) over June 2025, find the single hour timestamp with the highest NO2. Then compute the mean traffic speed (from the hourly road-segment traffic records) at that same timestamp across the road segments whose geometry lies within 300 metres of the station (non-NULL speed). Return that peak NO2 value (1 dp) and the mean speed (2 dp).

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Find peak NO2 at Causeway Bay station (id=17) in June 2025
# June 2025: from 2025-06-01 00:00 to 2025-07-01 00:00 (exclusive end)
query_peak_no2 = text("""
SELECT no2, datetime
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 17
AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
ORDER BY no2 DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
peak_df = pd.read_sql(query_peak_no2, engine)
print("Peak NO2 data:")
print(peak_df)

query_coords = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 17
""")
station_df = pd.read_sql(query_coords, engine)

print(station_df[['id', 'name_en']])
print(f"Coordinate: {station_df['coordinate'].values[0]}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Peak NO2 is 178.9 at 2025-06-03 19:00:00
peak_datetime = '2025-06-03 19:00:00'
peak_no2 = 178.9

# Get station coordinates
query_coords = text("""
SELECT coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 17
""")
station_df = pd.read_sql(query_coords, engine)
station_coord = station_df['coordinate'].values[0]

# Find road segments within 300m of station AND with length <= 300m
# Then get mean speed at peak timestamp
query_speed = text(f"""
SELECT AVG(hrt.speed) as mean_speed
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrt.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrt.datetime = '{peak_datetime}'
AND hrt.speed IS NOT NULL
AND rs.length <= 300
AND ST_DWithin(
    rs.geometry::geography,
    '{station_coord}'::geography,
    300
)
""")
speed_df = pd.read_sql(query_speed, engine)
print(f"Mean speed at peak NO2 timestamp: {speed_df['mean_speed'].values[0]}")

# Store results
cwb_peak_no2 = round(peak_no2, 1)
cwb_peak_speed = round(float(speed_df['mean_speed'].values[0]), 2)

print(f"\nFinal results:")
print(f"cwb_peak_no2: {cwb_peak_no2}")
print(f"cwb_peak_speed: {cwb_peak_speed}")
